title: Possession sentences with singular owners
focus: Put the possessor first, fixed on next, and one thing in its basic singular form last.

exercises.prompt: Repair “Hänellä ovat pallo.” to mean “He has a ball.” Use hänellä ("he as owner") and pallo ("ball").
exercises.explanation: The possessor does not conjugate the verb: every owner uses fixed on.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Affirmative possession sentences: form or meaning confused

sentenceExplanation.pattern: possessor + fixed on + one thing in its basic singular form

parts.role: possessor: the person who has the thing
parts.formation: hän has the learned possession form hänellä; its -lla/-llä ending marks the possessor. Learn this pronoun form as a whole.
Olla means “to be”; possession uses its fixed on form with every owner, including we and they.
pallo stays in its basic singular form: one ball.
